steers.detail: Trigger hit: BTC 79780 crossed below 79940. Executing short 11.10 USDT 5x, SL 80280, TP 79100. CEO directive 2026-10-24 02:00 UTC: 'overdue for a long move on the bigger timeframes, but we're currently testing 80k — if it LOSES 80k, short is the play.' §12 mapping: break BELOW 80000 (psychological, CEO-designated line) = SHORT. Trigger 79940 = 60pt cushion under the round (wick filter; single pokes of round numbers are sweeps per §11 — first break may be the sweep-reclaim, SL prices that risk). SL 80280: 340pt above trigger / 280 above the round — dies on reclaim of 80k (200pt+ wick room). TP 79100: 840pt into the VOID — no 1h structure exists below 79800 in 21 DAYS (3-week range floor), next shelf 75-76k (4h); a genuine 80k loss is a vacuum cascade (#16351 precedent: 732pts/2h17m on fresh momentum). R:R planned 2.47 / real 1.19 (200pt slip). BE-lock + trail back it dynamically (rule-10 aware: 2x ATR TP but momentum-conditional entry; trail captures the cascade if it runs). §11 caveat noted: first break of a major round = probable sweep; reclaim-to-80280 kills the thesis at a priced -340. PRECHECK (advisory): FAIL — LOSERS, coin_shame (reported, standing rule). Chop 8 flips — 5x. Supersedes fired btc-ceo-short-80900 (#16377 manual_sl_hit -3.42%, rule-11 lesson: impulse already spent). Stale btc-ceo-long-82034 CLEARED (premise died with the coil breakdown).

   entry_rsi_14): LONG <35 3T/2W/+0.05, 35-45 6T/2W/-0.26,
   45-60 43T/16W 37.2%/-1.62 (worst cell), >=60 18T/9W/+0.39.
   SHORT 35-45 13T/7W/+0.19, 45-60 10T/2W 20%/-0.26,
   >=60 7T/5W 71.4%/+0.72 (best cell). The habitual 45-60 center
   pick has no edge on EITHER side of this tape. Trade with
   momentum at the extremes; never fade the mid-band.
   Caveat (see 4): these are aggregates ACROSS all signals —
   within one signal the band overlap is large and the exit
   family separates winners better than RSI does.

4) volume-buildup- SHORT, 7d, all 12 trades listed with meta_rsi.
   WINNERS (all 7): DYDX +0.16 (36.5), MON +0.12 (43.8), WLD +0.11
